race.comment: MISS ANNA MAE (4) finished sixth last start beaten 2.5 lengths at Murwillumbah over 1200m. Close up there and things are no tougher here. Appeals. STAFFO (6) finished in the middle of the pack last start at Ipswich. Is up in journey today and rates an each way chance. HAWAIIAN BLOOM (9) bounced back to form with a third place run at Gold Coast Poly after a less than encouraging tenth at Grafton two back. Good look at this on the latest rating/effort. DIAMOND OCEAN (7) finished ninth last start, and was well held at the Sunshine Coast over 1200m but comes back a notch for this and can do better.
